comparisons.limitation: Scene, door mechanics and push/pull direction change together; this is coverage, not isolated scene generalization.

protocol.model: same model snapshot and settings for all cases; freeze before runs
protocol.arm_initialization: body-native stowed posture; record actual joint state
protocol.policy_privileges: sensor observations and robot actuators only; no door-joint writes, teleportation, remote unlock or ground-truth task geometry

seed_status: Nominal measured-frame proposals; floor support, footprint collision and reachability must be validated before freezing.

body traverses the aperture between jambs; bypass around the room is rejected
entire body footprint reaches target side with 0.10 m plane clearance
ground support and final pose stable for 1.5 simulation seconds
success_contract.judge_input: trusted simulator telemetry, never agent claims

readiness.assets: Office handle overlap fixed with vertical D pulls and matched collision geometry; factory handle checked.
